title: Concept: Gradle explicitly permits an insecure repository protocol
description: build.gradle declares a repository with `allowInsecureProtocol = true`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Gradle only talks cleartext here because the build was told to allow it, so the override is a deliberate decision to drop transport protection.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: Gradle only talks cleartext here because the build was told to allow it, so the override is a deliberate decision to drop transport protection.
